We're a boutique, doctor-led med spa where medical expertise meets genuine warmth—no corporate coldness, no sales pressure, just seriously good skin and seriously good vibes. Unlike most Nashua med spas, our board-certified doctors don't just oversee treatments—they perform them. Combined with our honest, no-pressure approach and personalized care, you get the confidence of medical-grade treatments in an environment you actually enjoy being in. Here's what makes us different: ✓ Doctor-performing treatments on-site (not just oversight) ✓ Boutique, family-owned —not a franchise or chain ✓ Honest recommendations over sales tactics ✓ Comfortable for first-timers and med spa regulars alike ✓ Natural-looking results that help you look like you We're proud to be Nashua's trusted med spa, recognized for combining 40+ years of medical experience with the kind of personalized attention you won't find at larger chains. I’m looking forward to going back to them” Meet The Owners, Drs. Sanjay and Neera Gupta We're Dr. Sanjay and Dr. Neera Gupta, and we started Sansa because we wanted to create a different kind of med spa experience—one where medical expertise meets a truly comfortable, personal environment. After decades in medicine—Dr. Sanjay as a surgeon and Dr. Neera in internal medicine and obesity care—we saw firsthand how aesthetic concerns can impact confidence and quality of life. We also experienced it personally. We've been on the other side as patients, dealt with skin issues in our own family, and felt the vulnerability that comes with seeking aesthetic treatments. That's why we built Sansa to be different: a boutique practice where you get hour-long appointments, honest recommendations, and personalized care—not the rushed, insurance-driven model we left behind. Here, you're never just another appointment. We take the time to truly understand your concerns and goals, and we're with you every step of the way. Our goal is to be the best med spa in Nashua, NH. No matter your background, skin type, or experience level with med spas, you'll be treated with the same kindness, medical precision, and attention to detail we'd give our own family. We can't wait to meet you and help you feel like yourself again—confident, cared for, and genuinely comfortable in your own skin. How It Works 1.
